name: Libra — Weekly sales report per seller

parameters.query:
-- One row per seller and currency with last week's order funnel and top products.
with week as (
  select * from public.orders where created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
), top as (
  select o.seller_id, o.currency, p.name_es as name, sum(oi.quantity) as quantity,
         row_number() over (partition by o.seller_id, o.currency order by sum(oi.quantity) desc) as rank
  from week o
  join public.order_items oi on oi.order_id = o.id
  join public.products p on p.id = oi.product_id
  group by o.seller_id, o.currency, p.name_es
)
select s.email as seller_email,
       coalesce(s.display_name, s.email) as seller_name,
       w.currency,
       count(*)::int as orders,
       (count(*) filter (where w.payment_status = 'approved'))::int as approved,
       (count(*) filter (where w.payment_status in ('pending_verification', 'evidence_requested')))::int as to_review,
       (count(*) filter (where w.payment_status in ('pending', 'awaiting_payment')))::int as awaiting_payment,
       (count(*) filter (where w.payment_status in ('rejected', 'expired')))::int as lost,
       coalesce(sum(w.total) filter (where w.payment_status = 'approved'), 0)::int as revenue,
       coalesce((select json_agg(json_build_object('name', t.name, 'quantity', t.quantity) order by t.rank)
                 from top t where t.seller_id = s.id and t.currency = w.currency and t.rank <= 3), '[]') as top_products
from week w
join public.user_profiles s on s.id = w.seller_id
group by s.id, w.currency;
